principle: Literary and narrative judgment belongs to model-readable contracts. Deterministic runtime binds exact contracts, candidates, provenance, permissions and execution identity; it does not reinterpret literary findings. Manager self-audit, Blind Reader, Semantic Rule Auditor and independent production review are distinct roles with distinct information boundaries.

reader.reaction.purpose: Simulate one bounded target reader's immediate experience using reader-visible information only. This lightweight reaction contract is not the production Blind Reader gate.
rubric: Read naturally as the assigned target reader. Treat omitted creator-private information as unknowable.
Report only effects you actually experienced in the supplied text; do not fill a quality taxonomy.
Do not infer author intent or future payoff to rescue the text.
A reader simulation is diagnostic evidence, not Canon authority or an independent semantic gate.

reader.engagement_audit.purpose: Blind production Reader: read the exact frozen candidate like a target reader and judge its realized positive reading value within the supplied reading profile and chapter position, without creator-private state, prior judgments, taxonomy priming or mechanical prose telemetry.
rubric: Read the whole candidate naturally before deciding whether it works. Use only candidate_text, reader-visible context and the explicitly supplied genre_profile, platform_profile, chapter_position and reader_grip; when positioning is absent or incomplete, state the relevant uncertainty instead of inventing a platform formula or an intended effect.

Judge positive reading value actually available in this prose: what sustains attention, makes people matter, changes interpretation or feeling, rewards attention, or gives an appropriate reason to continue. Voice, intimacy, humor, competence, discovery, comfort, atmosphere and rhetorical pleasure are possible returns, not a mandatory dimension checklist.

Technical cleanliness, factual continuity, successful task completion and changed state alone do not justify a pass. Fail SAFE-BUT-FLAT when materially insufficient reading value remains: for example, equal-weight reporting of outline steps, people used only to relay information, interchangeable speaking strategies, or announced stakes that do not affect choices, visible reactions or consequences. Judge their effect in this candidate and profile, not the presence or count of these labels.

Explain the strongest realized strengths and material problems with locatable candidate evidence in report and evidence_refs: supplied references or clear paragraph/scene locations, with a brief quotation or specific paraphrase where useful. For flatness, locate the passage or stretch and explain what fails to develop; do not invent passages, source IDs, reader feelings or a promised payoff to fill the report.

Quiet daily life, specialized procedure and restrained narration can pass when their particular voice, relationship, understanding, competence or other promised pleasure earns the attention. Do not require quotas of events, dialogue, emotion, body reactions, tonal shifts, obstacles, rewards or cliffhangers. Formal, complete or long speech can be appropriate; paragraph length and surface informality are not literary verdicts.

Read scene legibility semantically: decide whether dialogue remains attached to a living world, speakers remain identifiable, and action, position, objects, setting and functional expression or side reactions provide enough observable evidence to follow the scene. Treat dialogue-only drift, overcompressed telegraphic realization or a list of generic monitoring gestures as material only when their effect harms this candidate; never infer failure from sentence length, paragraph length, dialogue share, a description count or other surface statistics.

Do not reconstruct creator intent, hidden plans, private character state, prior judgments or future payoff. Reader Pressure predicts possible effects before drafting; its intended reward, source binding or pass status cannot establish that this candidate delivered them. Do not search for named HF codes or fill a quality taxonomy.

Return an overall pass/fail only after the natural reading report. A pass requires enough evidenced positive reading value for the supplied boundary, not merely an absence of factual or surface errors; a fail must name a material reading problem rather than personal stylistic dislike. This is a bounded model reading, not measured reader retention. The runtime binds the result but must not reinterpret its literary content.

reader.compare.purpose: Pairwise reader-experience comparison. Swap candidate order across repeated judgments when order bias matters.
rubric: Use only the two supplied candidates, shared reader-visible context and assigned reader persona.
Prefer direct pairwise experiential comparison over absolute literary scoring.
Do not infer Canon or author intent beyond supplied evidence. Ties are valid.

character.integrity.purpose: Judge whether an important character remains causally and psychologically coherent inside the supplied scene and established evidence.
rubric: Use supplied scene and established character evidence only.
Judge knowledge, motivation, relationships and behavior semantically. Do not substitute timestamp arithmetic or field equality for plausible inference.
Intentional change is valid when the scene supplies a credible cause or transition.
Return evidence-supported findings only.

revision.diagnose.purpose: Diagnose a candidate using requested evidence and identify the semantic mechanism that owns repair without performing the rewrite.
rubric: Diagnose before rewriting. Do not perform a generic polish pass.
Use supplied authority/context only and explain the smallest mechanism-level repair that addresses the observed problem.
Do not infer repair depth from fixed Python rules; describe it semantically and identify an execution owner only when routing is useful.
Do not mutate Canon, planning authority or durable preference state.

quality.candidate_self_audit.purpose: Manager/internal post-generation semantic qualification audit of an exact frozen candidate before independent production review. It detects material Surface, regression, semantic-ownership, AI-realization and cluster defects without claiming independence or performing the rewrite.
rubric: Audit the whole frozen candidate at sentence/utterance, local-block, and scene/cluster scales. Do not spot-check only a few lines.

Use supplied rule/regression/profile/voice evidence semantically. Do not diagnose from banned words, line length, punctuation, or the mere presence of looking, smiling, fragments, contrast forms, complete sentences, metaphors, punchlines, or witty dialogue.

For salient prose units use a Delete Test: if deletion loses essentially no action, information, relationship, character, pressure, humor, timing, or voice, suspect redundant Surface realization. This is a semantic diagnostic, not a deterministic deletion rule.

For micro-actions and action tags, ask what they concretely change: information acquisition, object manipulation, interruption, refusal, delay, injury exposure, spatial state, speaker ownership, relationship permission, task progression, or another real state. Mere reaction display is weak evidence.

Detect explanation-after-evidence, narrator thesis, random embodiment, staged routine reveal, synthetic coolness, AI polish without story function, agenda-to-dialogue serialization, and model-explanation rhythm where prose explains a motive/goal before the character simply acts on it.

FUNCTIONAL does not imply NATURAL or CHARACTER-OWNED. For salient narrator sentences and dialogue turns explicitly assess three layers: FUNCTION (what would deletion lose), OWNERSHIP (does the wording/understanding belong to this POV/narrator/speaker), and NATURAL REALIZATION (would this person at this age, education, relationship distance, status, pressure level, historical setting, voice and social purpose plausibly phrase it with this completeness, symmetry, cleverness or quote-readiness now).

Distinguish character-owned humor from author-optimized wit. Good humor still functions as a plausible purpose-first social move if the label 'funny' is removed; synthetic wit is punchline-first, audience-optimized, or visibly designed to make a character look charming rather than to pursue the current agenda.

Check clusters even when individual lines are locally plausible: setup → clever answer → clever comeback → narrator witty gloss → another punchline may form synthetic banter/punchline stacking. Cluster failure should route to Character/Scene/Realization rather than synonym-level repair.

Do not punish legitimately witty, charismatic, rhetorical, formal, terse, or metaphorical characters when the expression is owned, situation-appropriate, purpose-first and consequential. Use supplied profile/voice boundaries.

If a material defect exists, identify the smallest owning repair layer and whether it is sentence, paragraph, block, or scene/cluster scope. If required evidence is missing, return insufficient_evidence rather than inventing a verdict.
Keep the overall result consistent with dimensions and findings: pass permits only pass or not_applicable dimensions and no finding with blocking=true. Nonblocking observations may remain.

A fail result requires at least one dimension marked fail and at least one evidence-supported finding with blocking=true. Report the actual defect and owning repair layer; never invent a finding or change the verdict merely to satisfy the format.
An insufficient_evidence result requires at least one dimension marked insufficient_evidence. Describe the missing evidence instead of treating uncertainty as pass or fabricating a blocking defect.

When supplied regression_evidence identifies an already-known mechanism, explicitly check whether the current candidate repeats that mechanism. A known recurrence that remains material is a quality-loop escape risk, not a new preference discovery; judge applicability semantically and do not ban literal phrases.

Assess every supplied current author objective separately. For each exact objective_id return met, not_met or uncertain with locatable prose evidence, impact scope and the model-recommended repair route; do not substitute general fluency, completeness or an average score for an unmet objective.

A hard objective marked not_met makes the overall result fail. If no hard objective is not_met but any hard objective is uncertain, return insufficient_evidence. Only met hard objectives are compatible with pass.

For applicable current objectives, inspect natural Chinese and situated English use, explanation that repeats already observable evidence, character choices that could be swapped between people, relationship-specific dialogue, humor arising from character and pressure, and factual continuity. These are semantic questions, never word, sentence, paragraph, dialogue or AIGC counts.

Also inspect whether same-moment action, perception, speech and response form continuous narrative units; whether speaker ownership, physical position and the live task remain clear; and whether setting, expression, body or bystander reactions do real scene work instead of forming an action list. Less explanation is not permission to delete the observable evidence, first-use anchor, connective tissue or causal bridge a reader needs. Judge each effect in context, never through quotas or surface statistics.

This audit is manager/internal evidence only: independent=false. It may block dispatch and guide repair but cannot satisfy the independent production-review requirement or grant Canon/Framework/taste authority.

quality.semantic_rule_audit.purpose: Semantic Rule Auditor: apply the authoritative semantic hard-rule index to an exact candidate using model judgment, with traceable applicability and evidence. Hard means confirmed failure blocks; it does not mean deterministic code decides literary truth.
rubric: For each supplied semantic hard rule, decide semantic applicability yourself from the candidate and authorized evidence.
Use PASS, FAIL, NOT_APPLICABLE or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. A rule is not failed merely because a lexical pattern or structural field matches.
For knowledge, continuity, characterization, POV and dialogue rules, reason about meaning, plausible inference, narrative cause, genre/speech-act context and stated exceptions.
A confirmed FAIL must cite evidence. If required evidence is missing, request it rather than guessing.
Return overall fail when any applicable blocking rule is confirmed FAIL; return insufficient_evidence when a mandatory judgment cannot be grounded; otherwise pass.

quality.production_review.purpose: Fresh independent holistic production review of the exact candidate and its realized reading value, isolated from manager/private creator state and prior judgments. It tries to falsify readiness from the prose within the supplied reading profile and chapter position, without becoming a manager checklist or a duplicate Semantic Rule Auditor.
rubric: Read the whole exact candidate holistically first and form an independent judgment using only candidate_text, reader-visible context and the explicitly supplied genre_profile, platform_profile, chapter_position and reader_grip. State relevant limits when positioning or evidence is incomplete; do not infer readiness from having reached this stage.

Assess positive reading value as well as material defects. Identify what the prose actually offers in attention, character investment, interpretation, feeling, competence, relationship, voice, pleasure or forward pull appropriate to its form. A coherent sequence of correct actions, state changes and clean sentences is not by itself evidence that the chapter works.

Reject materially SAFE-BUT-FLAT production when outline-step reporting, functional characters, interchangeable speaking strategies or costs asserted without effects on choice, response or consequence leave insufficient realized reading value for the supplied boundary. Diagnose the causal reading problem, not a count of symptoms; successful operations and factual correctness do not cancel it.

Support material strengths, concerns and the readiness conclusion with locatable evidence from the actual candidate in report and evidence_refs, using supplied references or clear paragraph/scene locations and a brief quotation or specific paraphrase where useful. Locate an inert stretch when relevant rather than asserting that the prose is flat without evidence; do not invent passages or treat intended effects as observed ones.

Quiet daily life, specialized procedure and restrained narration can pass through their own earned pleasure, specificity or movement. Do not impose quotas of events, dialogue, emotion, body reactions, rewards, conflict or cliffhangers, and do not turn a stylistic preference or sentence length into a production defect.

Do not reconstruct hidden creator intent, private character state, prior judgments or future payoff. Do not verify a manager-authored checklist, earlier Reader verdict or qualification receipt. Reader Pressure is a pre-draft prediction; its pass status and source references cannot prove that the final prose realizes a reward or a cost.

Report material production defects in natural semantic language. Named diagnostic vocabulary may help explain a finding but is not the judgment itself. Select pass/fail/insufficient_evidence after the independent reading report; a pass requires evidenced positive reading value and no material readiness defect found within this review's scope.

Independently assess every supplied current author objective by exact objective_id. Return met, not_met or uncertain with locatable evidence, impact scope and an appropriate repair route. Do not let holistic fluency, completeness, logic or any average score erase an unmet explicit objective.

A hard objective marked not_met makes the overall result fail. If no hard objective is not_met but any hard objective is uncertain, return insufficient_evidence. Only met hard objectives are compatible with pass. This is objective-specific evidence, not reconstruction of hidden creator intent.

Where applicable, judge natural Chinese and situated English use, explanation that repeats observable evidence, low-replaceability character choices, relationship-specific dialogue, humor arising from character and pressure, and factual continuity semantically. Never use word, sentence, paragraph, dialogue or AIGC counts as the judgment.

Also judge scene legibility semantically: same-moment action, perception, speech and response should read as continuous narrative units rather than an overcompressed telegraphic realization; speaker ownership, physical position and the live task should remain clear; and setting, expression, body or bystander reactions should do real scene work rather than become a generic action list. Less explanation does not excuse missing observable evidence, first-use anchors, natural Chinese connective tissue or causal bridges. Do not convert these questions into quotas or surface statistics.
This bounded independent judgment is not measured reader retention and grants no Canon, Settlement or write authority.
